message.content: According to the records, two individuals wished Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year. These were WolfgangSchulz and JenniferMoore. WolfgangSchulz sent his greetings at 09:30 on January 19th, wishing Li Hua a "fantastic celebration and lots of yummy food." JenniferMoore expressed her wishes at 14:30 on the same date, wishing Li Hua a "fantastic celebration" and hoping she had a "great time celebrating!"
